// OFFICE PRODUCTIVITY UTILITIES

> PRICE TRACKING

MATCHING RECORDS: 4

  • SteamDB Sales & Price Tracker:
    An independent, community-driven utility that tracks real-time Steam price changes, historic lows, and active publisher sales without intrusive ads, tracking garbage, or affiliate dark patterns.
  • CamelCamelCamel:
    A zero-signup price tracking service that maintains historical price charts and drop alerts for Amazon product listings without requiring browser extension installs.
  • Keepa:
    The gold-standard Amazon price tracking utility that embeds detailed price history charts, sales rank metrics, and drop alerts directly into product pages.
  • Idealo:
    A comprehensive price comparison platform that aggregates live retail offers, shipping costs, and price histories across thousands of merchant stores.
